==Description==
'''D-20''' is a stationary [[Entities|entity]]. It looks like an upside down face, with 2 big, dark eyes and mouth full of teeth.

==Behavior==
'''D-20''', when spawning, will warn other players by emitting a few particles in the location where it will spawn. After 2-3 seconds, '''D-20''' will spawn, making a loud beep sound and revealing it's face.

After '''D-20''' has spawned, any player who get too close to it will get damaged. After approximately 1 minute and 45 seconds it will dissapear, making a low-pitched sound of it's spawn sound.

==Strategy & Tips==
*If you have some healing [[Items|items]], you can freely go though it but not stay for too long, as '''D-20''' still pose a threat.
*If you don't have any healing items, avoid '''D-20'''.
*'''D-20''' can block [[D-5]]'s view, so use it as your advantage. (The only good point of '''D-20''' tho).

==Trivia==
*'''D-20''' can be killed with any [[Items|weapon]].
*There's a very low chance that '''D-20''' will spawn on every single slot in one room, having up to 6 clones.
*[[SHA-120]] can run over '''D-20''' causing him to despawn instantly.
*'''D-20''' used to be called D-1.
